sources.snippet:
Far-right senator and family land in US after crossing from Brazil into Argentina and then flying via Ecuador

A private jet carrying the Brazilian far-right senator Flávio Bolsonaro has landed in Miami, Florida, where the losing candidate in Sunday’s presidential election runoff left the airport under police escort without speaking to the press.

After losing Sunday’s election to the incumbent president, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, Bolsonaro disappeared for more than 24 hours, until Argentina’s migration authorities said

sources.snippet: A Fidelidade rejeitou esta quarta-feira estar a recusar indemnizar as vítimas e as famílias afetadas pelo acidente do Elevador da Glória, em Lisboa. Em comunicado, a seguradora afirma manter o compromisso com a justa indemnização dos lesados e lamenta que "algumas expressões" utilizadas em peças processuais "possam ter causado sofrimento acrescido".

sources.snippet: Uncertainty hung over Israel’s election Wednesday as neither Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s right-wing, religious bloc nor the bloc formed by his centrist rival Gadi Eisenkot appeared to be heading for a majority in the Knesset. But there was a surprise: an unusually strong showing by Arab parties could make them unexpected kingmakers.
sources.title: Arab parties ‘have woken up’: Israel's uncertain election may deliver surprise kingmakers

sources.snippet: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing bloc was leading opposition rival Gadi Eisenkot. Arab parties had a strong showing, and a key question now is whether Eisenkot's bloc will consider forming a coalition with them.
sources.title: Partial results from Israel's contentious election show no clear winner
